complete_examples.text: It is well known that these types of rail profile defects have obvious periodic and short-wavelength characteristics that cause notable wheel/rail interaction forces.

It is therefore urgent to conduct an in-depth work to build a mathematical relationship, implicit or explicit, between track irregularities and wheel/rail interactions based on the wheel/rail interaction mechanisms.
